settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your email address, password and the emails you get.
settings.emailChanged: Your email address is changed to {email}.
settings.emailDescription: Where we send sign-in links and notifications.
settings.passwordDescription: Used to sign in with your email.
settings.alwaysSent: Emails about decisions on your products or account, and about the outcome of reports you send, are always sent. Sign-in and password emails are too.

email.newHint: We send a link to both addresses. The change is made once both are confirmed.

password.withProvider: Your account signs in with {provider}. You can also choose a password, to sign in with your email address.
password.sendLink: Send a link to choose a password
password.newHint: At least {min, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}. Your other devices are signed out.
password.forgot: Do not remember your current password?
password.sendNewLink: Send a link to choose a new one

notifications.messagesHint: One email per conversation, only when a message is still unread after a few minutes. It never contains the message.
notifications.milestonesHint: When a product's shared MRR passes an amount such as $1K, or it reaches the top 10. Once per milestone, with a card to share.
notifications.reportsHint: For admins. At most one email an hour.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently deletes your account and everything in it. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.whatGoes: Your profile, your products and their logos, your payment provider connections with the stored keys, all verification history, the reports you sent and your conversations are deleted, also for the users you wrote with. Your products leave the leaderboard at once.
deleteAccount.keys: Keys you created stay with your payment provider until you delete them there. See the <link>privacy policy</link> for what we store.
deleteAccount.confirmed: You confirmed with {provider}. Delete your account within five minutes.
deleteAccount.confirmFirst: Your account signs in with {provider}. Confirm it is you with {provider} first.
deleteAccount.failed: {provider} did not confirm it is you. Please try again.

deleteProduct.title: Delete product
deleteProduct.description: Permanently deletes this product. This cannot be undone.
deleteProduct.whatGoes: The product page, its logo, its payment provider connection with the stored key, and all verification history are deleted, and the product leaves the leaderboard at once. Your profile and other products are not affected.
deleteProduct.connected: The payment provider account can then verify another product. The key stays with your provider until you delete it there.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Everything on your profile is public.
profile.introDescription: Shown at the top of your profile and next to your products.
profile.name: Name
profile.usernameHint: Shown as @username under your name, and used as your profile address. After a change, you can change it again in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
profile.usernameLockedHint: Shown as @username under your name, and used as your profile address. You can change your username again in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
profile.headline: Headline
profile.headlineHint: For example: Solo founder building tools for finance teams.
profile.locationHint: City and country, if you want to share it.
profile.linksDescription: Web addresses, with or without https://. LinkedIn, GitHub and X show with their icons.
profile.otherLinkHint: Any other profile, such as a newsletter or a podcast.
